import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    path_source_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_0.csv"
    path_source_1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_1.csv"
    path_source_2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_2.csv"
    path_source_3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_3.csv"
    path_source_4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_4.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df_intervencion = pd.read_csv(path_source_0)  # ['IdInterv', 'Intervencion']
    df_deteccion = pd.read_csv(path_source_1)     # ['IdDeteccion', 'Deteccion']
    df_main = pd.read_csv(path_source_2)          # main detailed data
    df_actividad = pd.read_csv(path_source_3)     # ['IdActividad', 'Actividad']
    df_causa = pd.read_csv(path_source_4)         # ['IdCausa', 'Causa']

    # --- Step 1: Prepare mapping dictionaries from source tables 0,1,3,4 ---
    # These will be used to map Id columns in df_main to their string descriptions

    # Intervencion mapping: IdInterv -> Intervencion
    # Note: df_main already has 'Intervencion' string column, but also has IdInterv in target schema.
    # The source 0 only has IdInterv and Intervencion, so we will join on 'Intervencion' string to get IdInterv.
    # But df_main has 'Intervencion' string, so we can merge on that to get IdInterv.
    # However, df_main does NOT have IdInterv column, so we will add it by merging.

    # Deteccion mapping: IdDeteccion -> Deteccion
    # df_main has 'Deteccion' string, but no IdDeteccion, so we will merge on 'Deteccion' to get IdDeteccion.

    # Actividad mapping: IdActividad -> Actividad
    # df_main has 'Actividad' string, no IdActividad, so merge on 'Actividad' to get IdActividad.

    # Causa mapping: IdCausa -> Causa
    # df_main has 'Causa' string, no IdCausa, so merge on 'Causa' to get IdCausa.

    # --- Step 2: Merge df_main with these mapping tables to get Id columns ---

    # Merge df_main with df_intervencion on 'Intervencion' to get IdInterv
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_intervencion, on='Intervencion', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_interv'))
    # Rename IdInterv column from df_intervencion (to avoid confusion)
    df_main.rename(columns={'IdInterv': 'IdInterv'}, inplace=True)

    # Merge df_main with df_deteccion on 'Deteccion' to get IdDeteccion
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_deteccion, on='Deteccion', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_detecc'))
    df_main.rename(columns={'IdDeteccion': 'IdDeteccion'}, inplace=True)

    # Merge df_main with df_actividad on 'Actividad' to get IdActividad
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_activ'))
    df_main.rename(columns={'IdActividad': 'IdActividad'}, inplace=True)

    # Merge df_main with df_causa on 'Causa' to get IdCausa
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_causa, on='Causa', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_causa'))
    df_main.rename(columns={'IdCausa': 'IdCausa'}, inplace=True)

    # --- Step 3: Select and reorder columns to match target schema ---

    # Target schema columns:
    target_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
        'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdInterv'
    ]

    # Note: Source df_main has 'Precipitaciones' column which is not in target schema, so we drop it.
    # Also, ensure all target columns exist in df_main after merges.

    # Check for missing columns and fill with NaN if needed
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df_main.columns:
            df_main[col] = pd.NA

    # Reorder columns
    df_target = df_main[target_columns]

    # --- Step 4: Data type conversions as per target schema ---

    # Define expected dtypes for target columns
    dtype_map = {
        'Fecha': str,
        'IdAhogado': 'Int64',
        'IdPersona': 'Int64',
        'Localidad': str,
        'Provincia': str,
        'CCAA': str,
        'Hora': str,
        'Latitud_inc': float,
        'Longitud_inc': float,
        'Sexo': str,
        'Edad': float,
        'Nacionalidad': str,
        'Origen': str,
        'Extraccion': str,
        'Causa': str,
        'TipoAhogamiento': str,
        'Factor': str,
        'Intervencion': str,
        'Pronostico': str,
        'Localizacion': str,
        'Riesgo': str,
        'Reanimacion': str,
        'Vigilancia': str,
        'Actividad': str,
        'Deteccion': str,
        'ID': 'Int64',
        'Estacion': str,
        'Estado': str,
        'Latitud_est': float,
        'Longitud_est': float,
        'T_med': float,
        'T_max': float,
        'T_min': float,
        'Presion': float,
        'Dir. vi.': float,
        'V_Viento': 'Int64',
        'Nubosidad': float,
        'ProfNievecm': float,
        'InsolacHoras': float,
        'Distancia': float,
        'IdActividad': 'Int64',
        'IdCausa': 'Int64',
        'IdDeteccion': 'Int64',
        'IdInterv': 'Int64'
    }

    # Convert columns to expected dtypes
    for col, dtype in dtype_map.items():
        if col in df_target.columns:
            try:
                if dtype == 'Int64':
                    # Use pandas nullable integer type conversion
                    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
                elif dtype == float:
                    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype(float)
                else:
                    df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype(dtype)
            except Exception as e:
                # If conversion fails, keep original and print warning
                print(f"Warning: Could not convert column {col} to {dtype}: {e}")

    # --- Step 5: Export the transformed dataframe to CSV ---
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
